title: RKM Entity Reference Definition
description: Defines a reusable stable reference to an existing RKM entity for embedded structures that need to point to first-class graph nodes without embedding the full entity.

id.description: Globally unique immutable identifier of the referenced RKM entity. This value is authoritative for graph export and cross-file linking.

entityType.description: Known RKM entity type of the referenced entity, constrained to the shared identity entity-type vocabulary.

slug.description: Optional filesystem-safe slug for readability, lookup and contributor review. The stable id remains authoritative.

name.description: Optional human-readable display name for the referenced entity.

role.description: Optional role played by the referenced entity in the local context.
